title: I've been using AI to help make an incremental game about a President who just wants to play golf lol
author: Junior_Muffin5931
selftext: So I've been working on a game called President of the Office, and I've been using Codex and Claude Code to help with the actual coding. The idea is pretty ridiculous lol. You're the President of the United States, but all you really want to do is play golf instead of running the country. Unfortunately, you still have approval ratings, emergencies, elections, staff, and a bunch of other bullshit to deal with. You gradually automate and delegate more responsibilities so you can spend more time golfing, but the longer you survive, the more shit starts piling up. Eventually your presidency ends, and you start over with permanent progression. The golf side has its own skills and increasingly difficult courses too. One of the biggest things I've been trying to get right is making sure the government doesn't become completely irrelevant once you've automated enough of it. I wanted something that could keep getting more complicated instead of being beaten in a couple of hours. I've been handling the game ideas, mechanics, balancing, and testing while using AI to help turn everything into an actual Android game. It's playable now, and I'm working on getting it onto Google Play. Anyway, here's about 2 minutes of actual gameplay. Figured some people here might find the whole thing interesting lol.
